experimental_method: Densities of aqueous NaCl, KCl, MgCl2, Na2SO4 and MgSO4 measured with a high-pressure magnetic-float densimeter (nonmagnetic Be-Cu bomb, 170 cm3) at 0, 25 and 50 C from 0 to about 1000 bar in 100-bar steps; apparent molal volumes phi_V computed from the densities with their eq 1.
uncertainties_stated: Bath controlled to 0.001 C, set to 0.005 C with a Pt resistance thermometer; pressures reproducible to 0.5 bar and accurate to 1.4 bar; density precision 3 ppm at a given T (8 ppm over the range), accuracy about 30 ppm at 1000 bar, equal to 0.3 cm3/mol in phi_V at 0.1 m and 0.03 cm3/mol at 1.0 m for 1-1 electrolytes.
quality_remarks: Footnote a: the 0.00 bar rows of phi_V are normalized to literature 1-atm values from the authors' eq 3 (not measured here). Apparent misprints or outliers kept as printed: Table II NaCl m=0.1299 at 1001.20 bar printed 31.133 (neighbours about 20.9-21.1); Table II MgCl2 m=0.2184 at 401.00 bar printed 21.199 above the 501.10 bar value 20.839; Table I NaCl m=1.307 at 601.00 bar 19.935 above 701.60 bar 19.353; Table I MgCl2 m=0.00876 identical 12.568 at 99.90 and 199.80 bar; Table I MgSO4 m=0.05328 identical 7.755 at 595.97 and 795.65 bar. Not corrected.

extraction_notes: The printed side-by-side molality columns of each salt were stacked as one block per (salt, molality) with a label row, as the spec's standard layout; values transcribed from the page image and checked by script: the multiset of all numbers (molalities, pressures, phi_V) equals that of the text layer except prose tokens, all clean. The table values are phi_V derived by the authors from measured densities (densities not tabulated), property recorded as other (apparent molal volume). Units cm3/mol from the paper text; molality is mol per kg of H2O as stated in the text. The second-and-third-table pressure grids differ per salt as printed.
